title: BluJem Daily Puzzle Processor — agent response
description: What the BluJem Daily Puzzle Processor Zia agent returns for one Daily Jumble image. It is an extraction only: scrambled words exactly as printed, circle positions, the clue and the answer layout. It never contains a solved word or the final answer.

status.description: OK when everything was read; STALE_SOURCE when the date printed on the puzzle is not the expected date; NEEDS_REVIEW when something could not be read with confidence.

puzzleDate.description: The date printed on the puzzle itself (ISO yyyy-MM-dd), or null when no date could be read.

expectedDate.description: The date the caller said to expect, echoed back (ISO yyyy-MM-dd). Optional.

source.description: Where the puzzle came from, e.g. "Hindustan Times Daily Jumble".

words.description: The four jumbled words, top to bottom, exactly as printed.

scrambled.description: The printed letters in printed order, uppercase A-Z only. Never unscrambled.

circledPositions.description: 1-based positions of the circled answer squares, ascending. Positions, never letters.

boxCount.description: How many answer squares the row has. Equals the number of scrambled letters.

finalClue.description: The sentence fragment leading into the final answer, word for word as printed.

finalClueSentenceCase.description: The clue in sentence case: a capital only at the start and on names. Same words, punctuation and dash as finalClue. Optional.

finalAnswer.description: The shape of the final answer — never its letters.

groups.description: Number of boxes in each group, left to right, e.g. [5, 2, 6].

prefix.description: Printed characters before the first group, e.g. an opening quotation mark. Empty string when none.

betweenGroups.description: What is printed between consecutive groups: one entry per gap (groups.length - 1). A plain space is " "; a hyphen is "-".

suffix.description: Printed characters after the last group, e.g. a closing quotation mark or "!". Empty string when none.

punctuation.description: Every punctuation mark printed around or between the boxes, in reading order, for checking.

cartoon.description: Where the cartoon panel is. The agent does not edit the cartoon.

imageIndex.description: When the puzzle came as several images, which one (0-based, in the order attached) holds the cartoon. Optional; 0 for a single image.

sourceReference.description: Free text: where the panel is on the image, e.g. "right half, framed panel with caption".

boundingBox.description: The panel's frame as fractions of the image that holds it (see imageIndex), 0-1, top-left origin. Optional.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in the whole extraction, 0-1.

needsReview.description: True whenever anything was uncertain; a person must check before publishing.

notes.description: Short notes on anything uncertain, for the admin. Never a hint or an answer.
